decision: Adopt the frozen representation/threshold candidate after both holdout budgets; use fixed-budget empirical null rather than an uncertified Gumbel approximation.

protocol.split: global achiral Murcko scaffold SHA256 first 8 hex digits modulo 5
protocol.selection_metric: mean reciprocal rank of first known target
protocol.adoption: selection winner only; independent test paired scaffold-bootstrap 95% lower MRR gain > 0 and Recall@10 lower gain >= -0.02; otherwise retain baseline
protocol.interpretation: Known-active target retrieval only; unmeasured targets are not inactive. No precision, false-positive, FDR or binding-probability claims.

limits: The candidate was frozen using selection data only; test data cannot select another candidate.
Pointwise paired-bootstrap intervals resample unique query scaffolds; shared targets may still induce dependence.
Study null streams have the same marginal definition but differ from production size-keyed streams.
Study budgets are 8191/32767, below the production Balanced budget; rankings can change with Monte Carlo resolution.
Known-active target retrieval only; unmeasured targets are not inactive. No precision, false-positive, FDR or binding-probability claims.
A retrieval improvement does not establish calibrated Gumbel tails; validate those independently before adoption.

protocol.query_partition: same untouched 512 scaffold test queries as fixed protocol
protocol.candidate: only frozen selection winner; no replacement if it fails
protocol.adoption: both the original holdout criterion and production-budget paired MRR lower bound > 0 and Recall@10 lower bound >= -0.02 must pass
protocol.interpretation: Rechecks numerical-budget stability on the same biological holdout, not an independent second biological replicate.

production.limits: Same fixed scaffold holdout as the earlier comparison, re-evaluated at the production budget; not another independent biological replicate. Candidates remain frozen.
production.timing_scope: Elapsed time covers this invocation only; reused null distributions may have been generated earlier. This is not an end-to-end sampling performance benchmark.

legacy_gumbel_audit.null: independent uniform molecule sets; no replacement within sets; overlap across sets permitted
legacy_gumbel_audit.interpretation: Independent simulations under the implemented uniform-set null, not biological inactive compounds. One-sided binomial excess tests use Bonferroni over declared size/level checks. Finite simulations do not validate arbitrarily small tails or all intermediate set sizes.

empirical_null_audit.test: One-sided beta-binomial predictive tail accounts for the shared finite reference CDF. Bonferroni over 24 declared size/level checks. Ties use inclusive >= and remain conservative.
empirical_null_audit.limits: Uniform-set null only, not measured inactive compounds. Failure to detect excess does not prove biological calibration. Fixed-budget corrected Monte Carlo rank p-values also rely on exchangeability under the specified null.
